name: 5-APDI
summary: Commonly known as IAP.  A selective serotonin releasing agent with psychedelic and empathogenic properties. Users have often reported issues with the drug causing overheating and unwelcome bowel movements.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 5-APDI appears to act as a potent and weakly selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA) with IC50 values of 82 nM, 1,848 nM, and 849 nM for inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, respectively.

uses.text: The drug has been sold by online vendors through the Internet and has been encountered as a designer drug starting in 2003.

summaryZh: 5-APDI（化學名：5-(2-氨丙基)-2,3-二氫-1H-茚，英語：5--2,3-dihydro-1H-indene，別名有indanylaminopropane、2-aminopropylindane、indanametamine等）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C12H17N，屬於安非他命衍生物，能作為迷幻藥物。

sideEffects.en: Users commonly report overheating and an urgent need to empty the bowels. As a strong serotonin releaser, it also carries risks of dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 使用者常提到體溫過高與急著想排便。作為強力的血清素釋放劑，它也有危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成低血鈉，以及血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 用户常提到体温过高与急着想排便。作为强力的血清素释放剂，它也有危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成低血钠，以及血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: Its street name IAP comes from its chemical name, 5-(2-aminopropyl)indane. Its indane ring is a benzene ring fused to a five-carbon ring, which holds the molecule in a fixed shape.
fact.zh: 它的街頭名稱「IAP」來自化學名稱5-(2-aminopropyl)indane。它的茚環是苯環與一個五碳環相連而成，使分子維持固定的形狀。
fact.zhHans: 它的街头名称「IAP」来自化学名称5-(2-aminopropyl)indane。它的茚环是苯环与一个五碳环相连而成，使分子维持固定的形状。
